title: 过去与将来
goal: 一般过去时、将来时、现在完成时入门

lessons.title: 一般过去时：was / were 与规则动词

steps.title: 昨晚
lines: You look tired. Did you stay up late?
Yes. I watched a movie and studied until two.
是。我看了部电影，又学到两点。
Were you at home all evening?
No, I was at a friend's place.

steps.title: 一般过去时：过去某个时间，已经结束
what: 说过去某个时间发生、已经结束的事：yesterday, last night, two years ago, in 2019, when I was a child
be：I / he / she / it → was；you / we / they → were
规则动词加 -ed：work → worked，live → lived，study → studied，stop → stopped
否定和疑问借 did，动词回原形：I didn't go. Did you see it?
why: 英语动词本身带着时间信息。一说 worked，听的人就知道是过去的事，所以英语句子里时间词有时可以省，动词的过去式却不能省。
zh: 中文靠“了”“昨天”表示过去，动词不变：“我昨天去公司”“我去了”。英语即使有 yesterday，动词也必须变：I went to work yesterday. 最常见的错误是忘记变形（I go there yesterday），以及 did 之后还用过去式（Did you went?）。
ex: I moved here two years ago.
我两年前搬到这里。
We were at home last night.
我们昨晚在家。
She studied until two.
她学到两点。
Did you call him? — No, I didn't.
你给他打电话了吗？——没有。
steps.sum: 过去时间 → 动词过去式；did 一出现，动词回原形。

a: I moved here two years ago.
Were you at home last night?
Were you home last night?

steps.title: -ed 的三种读法：/t/、/d/、/ɪd/
what: 清辅音（p k f s sh ch）后读 /t/：worked, stopped, watched
浊辅音和元音后读 /d/：played, lived, called
t / d 后读 /ɪd/，多一个音节：wanted, needed, started
why: 和 -s 的三种读法同一个道理：跟着前面的音走，省力。只有 t/d 后面加不进 /t/ /d/，才插一个 /ɪd/。
zh: 中国学生常把 -ed 一律读成“得”，或把 worked 读成两个音节“沃克德”。听力里过去式全靠这个微弱的 /t/ /d/ 来分辨。
ex: worked /t/ · played /d/ · wanted /ɪd/
I watched TV and called my mom.
我看电视，给妈妈打了电话。
err: 只有 t/d 后才加音节
steps.sum: 只有 t / d 后面的 -ed 才多一个音节。

x: I moved here two years ago.
What did you do last night?
I stayed up late last night.

steps.text: I watched a movie and studied until two.
steps.zh: 我看了部电影，又学到两点。

a: stayed

steps.a: I moved here two years ago.
I stayed up late last night.

a: I didn't go out last night.
I did not go out last night.

points: 重点：过去某时已结束 → 一般过去时；was / were；-ed；否定疑问用 did + 原形。
重点：-ed 读法 /t/ /d/ /ɪd/，只有 t、d 后多一个音节。
… ago 以前；stay up late 熬夜。

steps.title: 周末的派对
lines: Did you have a good time at the party?
Yes! I met a lot of people and made some new friends.
开心！认识了很多人，交了几个新朋友。
But I took a taxi home and left my phone in it.
但我打车回家，把手机落在车上了。
steps.note: met、made、took、left —— 最常用的动词，偏偏是不规则的。

steps.title: 最常用的 30 个不规则动词
body: go → went　come → came　get → got　make → made　take → took　see → saw　say → said　know → knew
give → gave　find → found　think → thought　tell → told　become → became　leave → left　feel → felt　put → put
bring → brought　buy → bought　begin → began　keep → kept　hold → held　write → wrote　stand → stood　hear → heard
let → let　meet → met　run → ran　pay → paid　sit → sat　speak → spoke
规律帮助记忆：-ought / -aught 一组（bought, brought, thought, caught, taught）；不变的一组（put, cut, let, set, hit）。
ex: I bought a new phone and gave the old one to my sister.
我买了新手机，把旧的给了妹妹。

steps.title: 不规则动词：成组记，比一个个背快
what: -ought / -aught：buy → bought，bring → brought，think → thought，teach → taught，catch → caught
i → a：begin → began，drink → drank，sing → sang，swim → swam
ee / ea → e + t：keep → kept，sleep → slept，feel → felt，meet → met，leave → left
不变：put, cut, hit, let, set, cost, shut
完全不规则：go → went，be → was/were，have → had，do → did，make → made，take → took，see → saw，say → said，get → got
why: 最常用的动词最不规则：因为它们用得太多，古老的变形一直没被“规则化”。好消息是数量有限，最常用的 50 个覆盖了日常 90% 的情况。
zh: 中国学生常给不规则动词加 -ed（<s>buyed</s>、<s>thinked</s>），或把 bought（买）和 brought（带）混淆。
ex: I bought a gift and brought it to the party.
我买了礼物，带到了派对。
We met at nine and left at eleven.
我们九点见面，十一点离开。
I put it on the table.
我把它放在桌上了。（put 不变）

a: left

drill.zh: 我们在派对上玩得很开心。
a: We had a good time at the party.
We had a great time at the party.
We had fun at the party.

x: We had a good time at the party.
我们在派对上玩得很开心。

steps.text: I met a lot of people and made some new friends.
steps.zh: 认识了很多人，交了几个新朋友。

steps.q: We ___ a great time last weekend.

a: made
Let's take a break.
Let's have a break.

points: 最常用的 30 个不规则动词要背熟：went, came, got, made, took, saw, said, knew…
重点：成组记 —— bought / brought / thought、began / drank、kept / felt / met / left、put / cut 不变。
have a good time 玩得开心；make a mistake 犯错；take a break 休息。

lessons.title: 将来时：will 与 be going to

steps.title: 下周的计划
lines: What are you going to do next week?
I'm going to visit my parents.
I'll get it. I'll call you back as soon as I can.
我来接。我尽快给你回电话。
steps.note: will 和 be going to 都说将来，但不能随便换。

steps.title: will 还是 be going to
what: be going to + 原形：说话前已经打算好的事；眼前有迹象的预测
I'm going to visit Paris next month.（早就计划好了）　Look at the clouds — it's going to rain.
will + 原形：说话时临时决定；承诺、提议；一般的预测
The phone's ringing. — I'll get it.（刚决定）　I'll help you.　I think it will be fine.
why: 两者的区别在于“决定是什么时候做的”：说话前就定了 → going to；说话这一刻才定 → will。
zh: 中文“我会”“我要”“我打算”都可能对应，很难直接对译。用这个问题判断：“这件事是我刚刚决定的吗？”
ex: I'm going to study abroad next year.
我明年要出国留学。（早有打算）
— I'm hungry. — I'll make you a sandwich.
——我饿了。——我给你做个三明治。（刚决定）
Look at those clouds! It's going to rain.
看那些云！要下雨了。
I'll call you later.
我晚点打给你。（承诺）
err: The phone is ringing. — I'm going to get it.
I will visit my parents next week, I booked the tickets already.
I'm going to visit my parents next week.
steps.sum: 早有打算 → going to；刚刚决定、承诺 → will。

drill.q: — The phone is ringing. — I ___ get it.
Look at those clouds! It ___ rain.
We ___ visit our grandparents next Sunday. (已经计划好)

a: I'll call you back later.
I will call you back later.

steps.title: when / if / as soon as 从句：用现在时表示将来
what: 时间和条件从句里，用一般现在时代替将来时：
I'll call you when I get home.（不说 when I will get）
If it rains tomorrow, we'll stay home.
I'll tell you as soon as I know.
why: 主句已经用 will 表示了“将来”，从句只是说明条件 / 时间，不需要再重复一次将来。
zh: 中文“等我到家了，我会打给你”两个分句都可能带“会”，所以中国学生常写 <s>when I will get home</s>。这是托业第 5 部分的常考点。
ex: I'll call you when I get home.
我到家后给你打电话。
If it rains, we'll stay home.
如果下雨，我们就待在家里。
I'll tell you as soon as I know.
我一知道就告诉你。
err: I'll call you when I will get home.
I'll call you when I get home.
steps.sum: 主句 will，从句（when / if / as soon as）用现在时。

drill.q: I'll call you when I ___ home.
If it ___ tomorrow, we'll stay home.

a: I'll tell you as soon as I know.
I will tell you as soon as I know.

x: I'll tell you as soon as I know.

steps.text: I'll call you back as soon as I can.
steps.focus: I'll 轻读，CALL 和 BACK 重读

a: back

steps.a: I'll tell you as soon as I know.
I'll tell you as soon as I know.

points: 重点：早有打算、有迹象 → be going to；刚刚决定、承诺 → will。
重点：when / if / as soon as 从句用现在时表将来。
也可以用现在进行时说安排好的事：I'm meeting Tom tomorrow.

steps.title: 你去过京都吗？
lines: Have you ever been to Kyoto?
Yes, I've been there twice. I went there last spring.
去过两次。去年春天去的。
I've lived in Tokyo for three years, so come and visit!
我在东京住了三年了，来玩吧！
steps.note: I've been、I went、I've lived —— 现在完成时和一般过去时，这一课讲清楚它们的分工。

steps.title: 现在完成时 vs 一般过去时
what: 一般过去时：说过去某个具体时间的事 —— I went there last spring.
现在完成时 have / has + 过去分词：不提具体时间，关心和现在的关系：
① 经历（到现在为止有没有）：Have you ever been to Kyoto?
② 持续到现在：I've lived here for three years.
③ 结果影响现在：I've lost my key.（现在还找不到）
why: 判断方法：句子里有明确的过去时间（yesterday, last week, in 2019, ago）→ 只能用一般过去时；关心“到现在为止”→ 现在完成时。
zh: 中文“我去过京都”“我去年去了京都”靠“过”“了”和时间词区分；英语要选时态，而且具体过去时间不能和现在完成时连用：I have seen it yesterday.
ex: I've been to Kyoto twice.
我去过京都两次。（经历）
I went to Kyoto last spring.
我去年春天去了京都。（具体时间）
She has lost her phone.
她把手机丢了。（现在还没有）
I saw that movie last week.
我上周看了那部电影。
err: I have seen that movie last week.
I saw that movie last week.
steps.sum: 有具体过去时间 → 过去时；到现在为止 → 现在完成时。

a: I've never been to Japan.
I have never been to Japan.

steps.title: for 和 since；been 和 gone
what: for + 一段时间：for three years, for a long time
since + 起点：since 2020, since last May, since I was a child
has been to：去过（已经回来）；has gone to：去了（人还在那里）
why: for 量的是“多长”，since 指的是“从哪儿开始”。been / gone：be 表示“在过某处”，所以 been to = 去过；go 表示“离开去往”，所以 gone to = 去了还没回来。
zh: 中文“三年了”“从 2020 年起”分得很清楚，但写英语时常把 since 和 for 混用：<s>since three years</s>。
ex: I've lived in Tokyo for three years.
我在东京住了三年。
I've lived in Tokyo since 2022.
我从 2022 年起住在东京。
She has been to Paris.
她去过巴黎。
She has gone to Paris.
她去巴黎了（现在不在这儿）。
err: He has been to Beijing. He's still there.
steps.sum: for + 时长，since + 起点；been to 去过，gone to 去了。

drill.q: I haven't seen her ___ a long time.
a: for
since

drill.q: She ___ to Paris. She is still there.

x: I haven't seen him for a long time.
Have you ever been to Kyoto?

steps.focus: I've 轻读，BEEN 和 TWICE 重读

steps.a: Have you ever been to Kyoto?
Have you ever been to Kyoto?

a: I've lived here for ten years.
I have lived here for ten years.
I've been living here for ten years.
I have been living here for ten years.

points: 现在完成时 = have / has + 过去分词（been, done, gone, seen, eaten…）。
重点：有具体过去时间用过去时；经历、持续、结果影响现在用现在完成时。
重点：for + 时长，since + 起点；been to 去过，gone to 去了。

steps.title: 以前和现在
lines: Do you still live in Shanghai?
No, I used to live there, but I moved to Hangzhou last year.
不，以前住过，去年搬到杭州了。
These days I'm working from home. From now on, I'll study every day.
我最近在家办公。从现在起，我每天都学习。

steps.title: 用时间词选时态：五个时态放在一起
what: every day / usually / often → 一般现在：I work in Osaka.
now / at the moment / Look! → 现在进行：I'm working now.
yesterday / last … / … ago / in 2019 → 一般过去：I worked late yesterday.
ever / never / already / yet / for / since → 现在完成：I've worked here for two years.
tomorrow / next … / soon → 将来：I'll work from home tomorrow.
why: 托业第 5 部分的时态题，十有八九靠时间标志词就能做对。先找标志词，再看主语单复数。
zh: 中文时间词决定一切，动词不变；英语时间词决定动词形式。做题和写作时，先圈出时间词。
ex: He watches TV every evening.
他每晚看电视。
Don't call now — she's cooking dinner.
现在别打——她在做饭。
I lost my keys yesterday.
我昨天丢了钥匙。
We have known each other since childhood.
我们从小就认识。
I think it will snow tomorrow.
我想明天会下雪。
err: I have lost my keys yesterday.
We know each other since childhood.
We have known each other since childhood.

steps.title: used to：过去常常（现在不了）
what: used to + 动词原形：过去经常 / 过去是这样，现在不再了：I used to live in Shanghai.
否定 didn't use to；疑问 Did you use to …?
别和 be used to doing（习惯于）混：I'm used to getting up early.
why: used to 自带“今昔对比”：说 I used to smoke，对方就知道你现在不抽了。
zh: 中文“我以前住在上海”可以只是陈述过去；英语用 used to 时强调“现在不同了”。
ex: I used to live in Shanghai.
我以前住在上海。（现在不住了）
There used to be a cinema here.
这里以前有家电影院。
I'm used to working at night.
我习惯晚上工作。
err: I used to getting up early.（习惯）
I'm used to getting up early.
习惯于 = be used to doing
steps.sum: used to do 过去常常；be used to doing 习惯于。

a: used

o: I used to get up early.
I'm used to getting up early.
I use to get up early.

drill.zh: 这里以前有一家电影院。
a: There used to be a cinema here.
There used to be a movie theater here.

x: I used to live in Shanghai.
From now on, I'll study every day.

steps.text: I used to live there, but I moved last year.
steps.zh: 我以前住那儿，去年搬走了。

steps.a: From now on, I will study every day.
From now on, I will study every day.

steps.prompt: 写 4–5 句话：你过去怎样、现在怎样、将来打算怎样（用上 used to、现在完成时、be going to / will）。
steps.hint: 检查清单：每句先找时间词，时态对吗？过去分词写对了吗？
steps.focus: past simple, present perfect, used to, will / be going to
steps.model: I used to work in a bank in Shanghai. I moved to Hangzhou last year, and I've worked at a software company since then. I have never lived in a small city before, but I like it here. Next year I'm going to take the TOEIC test, so I will study English every day.

points: 重点：先圈时间词再选时态 —— every day 现在，now 进行，yesterday 过去，since / ever 完成，tomorrow 将来。
重点：used to do 以前常常（现在不了）；be used to doing 习惯于。
these days 最近；from now on 从现在起。

a: didn't see
